d: Short, vibrant crimson hair with straight bangs and a slight flip at the ends. Sharp, almond-shaped eyes in a vivid cyan blue. An adolescent appearance with a slender, petite build. Wearing a white and black maid-style dress featuring a red bow at the neck, a white apron with a black utility belt and pouches, and a white frilly headdress. Accessories include white gloves, white thigh-high stockings, a single grey mechanical knee guard on the right leg, and black sneakers with red laces, while holding a large black and red spear.
